name: Bible Companion
shortDescription: A free Bible-study app from Carelinks, a UK charitable incorporated organisation, with Bible text, commentary, audio, reading plans and a structured study course.
suitableContexts: Individuals seeking a no-cost Bible reading and study app
Churches or groups for which the New European Version and Carelinks' Christadelphian teaching context are appropriate
Multilingual users seeking English, Russian, Spanish, French or Farsi study resources

pricing.summary: Carelinks presents Bible Companion as a free, ad-free app. No paid plan is published in the reviewed material.

tiers.label: Bible Companion
tiers.detail: Bible text, audio, commentary, reading plan and Bible Basics study course

gdprInformation: No current privacy notice specific to Bible Companion was located in the reviewed public sources. Before recommending the app for a church programme, review the live app-store privacy disclosures and any account, tutor-contact or notification data handling.
coreFeatures: English, Russian, Spanish, French and Farsi versions
support: Carelinks offers online Bible study with a personal tutor through its website

uk-operator.value: Carelinks is a charitable incorporated organisation registered in England and Wales under charity number 1157202; the Charity Commission lists its Bath address and Carelinks UK as its website.

app-scope.value: Carelinks UK publishes direct Android and Apple download links for Bible Companion and describes Bible text, commentary, audio, a reading plan and a study course.

theological-context.value: Carelinks states that its charitable objects advance Christianity in accordance with its statement of faith, and its site presents the New European Version and its own Bible-study materials.

privacy.value: A current privacy notice specific to Bible Companion was not found in the reviewed public sources.

editorial.assessment: Bible Companion is a genuinely free Bible-study app supported by Carelinks, a UK charitable incorporated organisation. It combines Bible text, audio, commentary, reading plans and an online study course, making it a substantial no-cost option for personal use. Its teaching materials and New European Version are produced within Carelinks' own Christian tradition, so churches should assess theological fit before recommending it across a mixed congregation or using its content in formal teaching.
bestFor: Individuals wanting a free, ad-free Bible reading and study app
Users who value audio, reading plans and multiple language options
Groups that have assessed the Carelinks teaching context and the New European Version as suitable
strengths: Named UK charitable operator with an active Charity Commission record
Free and ad-free access stated by the supplier
Bible text, audio, commentary, reading plan and study course in one product
Published Android and Apple download routes
limitations: The app's theological and translation context may not suit every church or tradition
No current app-specific privacy notice was found in the reviewed public sources
It is an individual Bible-study resource, not church-management, safeguarding or worship-presentation software

procurementVerdict.problem: Finding a no-cost Bible-study resource with text, audio and structured study material
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A UK charity-backed, ad-free app with commentary, Bible Basics and multilingual versions
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Review the translation, commentary and Bible Basics material with a leader from your tradition, then check the current app-store privacy disclosure
